title: Make a pumpkin and melon farm

steps.title: Get seeds
steps.say: Craft a [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) into 4 [pumpkin seeds](item:pumpkin_seeds), or a [melon slice](item:melon_slice) into 1 [melon](item:melon) seed. Pumpkins grow wild in grassy places, and melons in [jungles](biome:jungle).

steps.title: Make farmland
steps.say: Use a [hoe](item:wooden_hoe) on [dirt](item:dirt) or grass next to water. Seeds grow best with water close by.

steps.title: Leave room
steps.say: Each stem grows its [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) or [melon](item:melon) on an empty block next to it. Leave a strip of plain [dirt](item:dirt) beside every row.

steps.title: Plant and wait
steps.say: Plant the seeds on the [farmland](item:farmland). The stems grow, then a [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) or [melon](item:melon) pops out next to them.

steps.title: Harvest the fruit
steps.say: Break only the [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) or [melon](item:melon), not the stem. The stem grows another one.

steps.title: Use them
steps.say: A [melon](item:melon) gives 3 to 7 [melon slices](item:melon_slice) to eat. Use [shears](item:shears) on a [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) to carve a face in it.
